_comment: Copy this file to config.json in the same directory, then fill in the three values below with what the network maintainer sent your facility. config.json is read by upload_bundle.py and never uploaded. endpoint_url may be the /ingest URL or the bare Worker origin; the uploader derives every route (single-shot and chunked) from it. Coordinator only: an optional "registry_token" key (the REGISTRY_TOKEN value) lets analysis/registry_report.py read the facility registry; facilities never need it.
